The following list highlights healthcare-sector stocks with Seeking Alpha EPS Revision Quant Grades A+. These grades reflect favorable changes in analysts’ earnings expectations ahead of Q3 results.

) and biopharmaceutical company Arcutis Biotherapeutics, Inc. (

The list also includes home and community-based care provider Aveanna Healthcare Holdings Inc. (AVAH) and healthcare services company BrightSpring Health Services, Inc. The broader group spans biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, medical devices, healthcare facilities, patient care services, and life sciences tools, with no specific market-capitalization restrictions applied.
